Topics discussed: Stay tuned for twice a week MeatEater Podcast drops starting in March; come to the Safari Club International 2026 Convention on Feb. 19th to see Steve and Morgan Potter; a correction on Colorado wolf recovery; sous vide rewarming for frostbite; the ins and outs of the New World screw worm; how all warm blooded critters are potential hosts; being eaten alive; Doug's Sharing the Land organization; and more. The New World Screwworm Threat Survey: https://acesnmsu.az1.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_eLjo05717Wzz1em The New World Screwworm is a serious pest threat to livestock and wildlife, and New Mexico is taking steps to stay proactive-not reactive. The survey gathers input from ranchers, producers, hunters, land stewards, and community members across New Mexico. We're studying what people know, believe, and need regarding screwworm prevention and response.

programme.title: Nico Is MISSING In Minecraft!

programme.title: BOYS vs GIRLS SECURITY HOUSE in Minecraft!
programme.desc: The boys and girls go head to head to see who can build the most secure house in Minecraft, packed with defenses to keep the other team out.

programme.title: Nico Got 1000% TALL In Minecraft!
programme.desc: Nico struggles with being short in Minecraft and sets out to become tall just like his friends, even if it means going to extreme lengths.

programme.title: Nico PROPOSES In Minecraft!
programme.desc: Nico finally works up the courage to propose to Zoey in Minecraft, with Cash and Shady secretly setting up the perfect special date for him.

programme.title: I Cheated with X-Ray in a Build Challenge!
programme.desc: Today, Nico and Cash go head to head in a Minecraft build competition, with Nico secretly using X-RAY to cheat. Will Cash discover Nico's secret, or will Nico win without being caught?

programme.title: GIRL HUNTERS vs BOY SPEEDRUNNER GRAND FINALE in Minecraft!
programme.desc: Today, it's GIRL HUNTERS versus BOY SPEEDRUNNER GRAND FINALE in Minecraft! Nico must survive the girls' hunt. Will they ever be able to catch Nico's professional speed running evasions? Watch to find out!

programme.title: We’re TRAPPED Inside A BLOCK In Minecraft!

programme.title: Zoey Is MISSING In Minecraft!
programme.desc: Today, Zoey goes missing in Minecraft after an accident occurs in her candy shop. Nico must figure out who is responsible for her disappearance. Watch to find out how he uncovers the mystery!

From losing her mind over trans people to her blatant use of racist tropes in the Harry Potter series, to cosplaying as a feminist then casting sex pests in her movies, this may just be our most close-minded guy, yet!

programme.title: What a Day
programme.desc: The GOP went all in on anti-trans messaging ahead of the midterms. According to the Human Rights Campaign, the party spent almost $400 million on campaign ads that targeted transgender people. But the hatred didn’t work. Joining Jane to talk about the historic wins trans and nonbinary candidates had this election season is State Legislator Leigh Finke, who was just re-elected in Minnesota.

programme.title: Strict Scrutiny
programme.desc:
This week, the Supreme Court heard oral arguments in two cases about accountability… or lack thereof. First, they heard a case that could make it more difficult to sue federal officers for Eight Amendment violations– interesting timing when ICE is running rampant. Then, a case about holding corporations accountable for mistreating their workers contained a disturbing takeaway: this Supreme Court seems to be further to the right than the Trump administration on corporate accountability.
Plus: Pete Hegseth’s attempted (and failed) impeachment, Scott Colom’s huge win in Mississippi, Senate Democrats skipping crucial judicial confirmation hearings, and a strange Fox news appearance from Justices Gorsuch, Barrett, and Kavanaugh.
Finally, Somil Trivedi, advocacy director and senior counsel at Court Accountability, joins Leah to talk about what Democrats can do now that they have the gavels.

programme.title: Pod Save America
programme.desc: What led Trump voters to finally flip to Democrats this year? To find out, we teamed up with Future Forward and Orchestra for a series of focus groups with two- and three-time Trump voters who voted for James Talarico and Gina Hinojosa in Texas, and Josh Turek and Rob Sand in Iowa. David Binder and Will Gudelunas, the pollsters who conducted the focus groups, stop by the studio to talk to Jon Favreau about what they learned over the eight hours of groups. Then, David Plouffe, Obama's 2008 campaign manager, talks to Jon about what stood out to him in the tape and what lessons it teaches campaigns ahead of the 2028 presidential election.

programme.title: Offline with Jon Favreau
programme.desc: Father Greg Boyle, founder of Homeboy Industries—the largest gang intervention organization in the world—and the priest who baptized both of Jon’s children, joins Offline to talk about his version of a politics of love, the lethal absence of hope that drives people to do terrible things, and what he means when he describes Donald Trump and Stephen Miller as unwell.

programme.title: This F*cking Guy
programme.desc: In our 52nd episode of This F*cking Guy, cultural critic & writer Emily St. James joins Erin to dive deep into the past of the web-sick hag, J.K. Rowling. From losing her mind over trans people to her blatant use of racist tropes in the Harry Potter series, to cosplaying as a feminist then casting sex pests in her movies, this may just be our most close-minded guy, yet!

programme.title: What a Day
programme.desc: The GOP went all in on anti-trans messaging ahead of the midterms. According to the Human Rights Campaign, the party spent almost $400 million on campaign ads that targeted transgender people. But the hatred didn’t work. Joining Jane to talk about the historic wins trans and nonbinary candidates had this election season is State Legislator Leigh Finke, who was just re-elected in Minnesota.

programme.title: Pod Save America
programme.desc: As the administration struggles to explain what caused Friday’s nationwide ground stop and what happened to all the money Congress appropriated for upgrades, Donald Trump says “I don’t take any responsibility” and blames Joe Biden and Pete Buttigieg. Jon, Jon, and Tommy talk about the administration’s incompetent and muddled response, the latest in the Nvidia scandal, and a presidential trip to China that’s now being overshadowed by infighting in Trump’s Cabinet. Then, Lovett sits down with MS NOW’s Rachel Maddow to discuss her new book, “Department of Fate,” and Tommy talks with Senator Chris Van Hollen about his bid to challenge Chuck Schumer for Senate Majority Leader.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: Alejandro returns home after a terrible accident to discover that he is married to Maria Jose, a poor, innocent girl who was deceived by Alejandro's brother Bruno. Bruno used Alejandro's name to marry Maria Jose, soon after he sent to kill his brother in hopes that Maria Jose would inherit Alejandro's fortune. But when Maria Jose arrives at the mansion she realizes that Bruno lied to her and used her. She is also scared when Alejandro is found alive and returns home. Doctors tell Alejandro that he suffers from memory loss but he is convinced he never met Maria Jose before and goes in search of the truth, but during this time and Maria Jose actually fall in love, while Bruno and Maura (Alejandro's ex-girlfriend) plot to break them up. Meanwhile, the brothers' mother Victoria has fallen in love with Fernando--Alejandro's best friend, so closer to his age than hers.

programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: Vikings

The Wessex/Viking forces charge into battle with Mercia. In Kattegat, Harbard arrives in to the Great Hall and his mysterious aura fascinates Aslaug and Helga but Siggy remains suspicious. programme.title: Vikings
programme.desc: The victorious Wessex/Viking forces return to Wessex but there is rancour in the Viking camp - Floki is angry over the alliance with Ecbert and is resentful the influence that he feels Athelstan has over Ragnar. Princess Kwenthrith makes some calculating political moves following the battle at the Hill of the Ash in Mercia. Visitors from the past arrive in Hederby, at Kalf's invitation.

programme.title: Vikings
programme.desc: The fleet returns to Kattegat to find tragic circumstances await. Lagertha learns that her Earldom has been usurped and convinces Ragnar to travel to Hederby with her in an effort to reclaim her title. Ragnar causes great surprise when he announces the next raid. The Seer has interesting prophecies for Rollo.

programme.title: Vikings
programme.desc: Preparations for the Paris raid pick up pace, and Rollo ponders the Seer's prophecy about his destiny. Ragnar is informed of Aethelwulf's massacre at the settlement in Wessex, and Kalf arrives in Kattegat with some new allies and some familiar faces. Porunn and Judith both deliver children; but with new life there is also death.

programme.title: Vikings
programme.desc: The appearance of the Viking fleet causes panic among the population of Paris. The defense of Paris is in the hands of its Commander, Count Odo, who is confident that the city is prepared for the attack. The Emperor Charles, urged by his daughter Gisla, announces in Court he will remain in the city. The Vikings establish camp downriver from the city and plan their attack.

programme.title: Vikings
programme.desc: The Viking army embarks and Paris goes into lockdown as the army prepares the defense, overseen by Count Odo. The Vikings are determined to make it through the gates of Paris and conquer the city; they will stop at nothing to succeed.

programme.title: Vikings
programme.desc: The Vikings go all out for a second assault on Paris. Recognizing the desperate state of affairs for his city, Emperor Charles must make a difficult decision. In Wessex, Judith is compelled to make a difficult decision of her own.

programme.title: Vikings
programme.desc: Rollo's destiny is recognized and Bjorn steps up as a leader. With one last chance to take Paris, Ragnar and his Vikings troops take a daring chance.
